map.负债总额 / 资产总额 使用指南: Total Liabilities / Total Assets User Guide
map.输入负债总额与资产总额，计算资产负债率，衡量企业长期偿债能力与杠杆水平，适用于财: Enter total liabilities and total assets to compute the debt ratio, measuring long-term repayment ability and leverage — for financial statement analysis, credit review and capital structure assessment.
map.资产负债率 = 负债总额/资产总额: Debt ratio = total liabilities / total assets
map.资产负债率 = 总负债 / 总资产。: Debt ratio = total liabilities / total assets.
map.评估企业长期偿债能力与资本结构风险。: Assess long-term repayment ability and capital structure risk.
map.债权人、评级机构与投资者衡量财务杠杆的核心指标。: The core leverage metric for creditors, rating agencies and investors.
map.监控负债率随扩张或还款的变动，预警过度杠杆。: Track the debt ratio as expansion or repayment proceeds, warning of excessive leverage.
map.：某公司负债总额 1500 万元、资产总额 5000 万元，资产负债率=1500: : a company with total liabilities of 15 million CNY and total assets of 50 million CNY has a debt ratio of 1500/5000=30%, i.e. 30% of assets are creditor-funded and leverage is low.
map.由营收、营业成本与费用求 EBIT: EBIT from revenue, operating cost and expenses
map.资产负债率多高算危险？: How high is the debt ratio considered dangerous?
map.无统一阈值，重资产行业（如公用事业）可容忍较高，轻资产或周期性行业宜偏低；一般认: There is no universal threshold: asset-heavy industries (e.g. utilities) tolerate more, while asset-light or cyclical industries should stay lower; above 70% financial flexibility clearly deteriorates.
map.资产负债率与产权比率有何关系？: What is the relationship between the debt ratio and the debt-to-equity ratio?
map.产权比率=负债/所有者权益，资产负债率=负债/(负债+权益)，两者都衡量杠杆，可: Debt-to-equity = liabilities / owner's equity, and the debt ratio = liabilities / (liabilities + equity); both measure leverage and convert into each other.
